dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: Well, I'd be remiss if I didn't mention that blow the experimental design bureau took. However you slice it, the Fatui have taken a hit — and aside from the Frostmoon Scions, plenty of other folks were plenty pleased about that setback.

dialogues.speaker: Demyan
dialogues.text: But... We probably shouldn't be talking about this in the open. We still have to do business with them, after all.
